name: Uesugi Kenshin
source:
"To protect you, I will become Shura once more."

Kenshin is known as the 'God of War', but he is a quiet man who wants to lead a peaceful life. He has a beautiful, neutral appearance and is often mistaken for a woman.

Temperament: Intelligent and sensual 
Likes: Sweet sake

[Information taken from the official character profile.]
